definitions.gloss: award ceremony; awards ceremony; prize-giving ceremony
definitions.explanation: A formal event at which prizes or awards are presented to recipients. Used for literary prizes, film awards, academic honors, and other recognition events.

examples.japanese: {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する。
examples.english: I will attend the award ceremony.

examples.japanese: {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}で{感動的|かんどうてき}なスピーチが{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A moving speech was given at the award ceremony.

examples.japanese: ノーベル{賞|しょう}の{受賞式|じゅしょうしき}は{毎年|まいとし}ストックホルムで{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: The Nobel Prize award ceremony is held in Stockholm every year.

notes:
Compound of {受賞|じゅしょう} ('receiving a prize') and {式|しき} ('ceremony'). Follows the productive {〜式|しき} pattern: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき} ('graduation ceremony'), {結婚式|けっこんしき} ('wedding ceremony'), {入学式|にゅうがくしき} ('entrance ceremony').

USAGE:
- Commonly encountered in news about film, literature, music, and academic awards
- The word focuses on the ceremony itself, not the act of winning — for the latter, use {受賞|じゅしょう}
- Often modified by the name of the specific award: ノーベル{賞|しょう}{受賞式|じゅしょうしき}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend an award ceremony
- {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}を{開催|かいさい}する: to hold an award ceremony
- {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}のスピーチ: award ceremony speech
- {年間|ねんかん}{受賞式|じゅしょうしき}: annual award ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {授賞式|じゅしょうしき}: award-giving ceremony — same reading, written with {授|じゅ} ('to grant') instead of {受|じゅ} ('to receive'); focuses on the giver's perspective
- {表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}: commendation ceremony — broader, includes recognition of merit not limited to prizes
- {式典|しきてん}: ceremony — general term for any formal ceremony
